reason: A session-reporting plugin that aggregates activity data into date-range digests and automates periodic reminders with local system notifications and saved reports.

summaries.zh: 按指定日期范围汇总会话活动并生成中英文工作报告，同时支持定期提醒、系统通知和报告保存。
summaries.en: Generates Chinese or English work reports from session activity for selected date ranges, with scheduled reminders, system notifications, and saved report files.

capabilities: Reads session-corpus data to aggregate activity statistics and per-session details
Generates AI-narrated or template-based reports for selected date ranges
Persists reminder configuration and generated reports in the user's home directory
Schedules periodic reminders and triggers operating-system notifications
